mentions.name: Spacedeck X
mentions.description: A desktop-only hybrid game combining shoot-em-up action with deck-building, playable in the browser via itch.io. Features a global high-score leaderboard that players, including the author's friends, compete on. Built with Kaplay, a small JavaScript gamedev library, over about 4-5 months of evening work; a possible future Steam release is being considered.
mentions.audience: Players, including folks who are not fans of one (or either) of the genres
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm still obsessed with making my game, which you can try it at the link above (it is desktop only). This is my first "real" game, and it has been incredibly fun and rewarding. I've been working on it in the evenings for about 4 or 5 months.

It is a very ambitious mix of genres - shoot-em-up and deck-building.
